statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is intended to capture intermittent cardiac events and assess for potential atrial or ventricular arrhythmias
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
